observations.title: Generated visualization recovery and replacement
observations.description: The Visualize guide distinguishes controls such as adjustable inputs, pause/restart and step navigation from the generated result itself. Follow-up can replace the visualization; blank output recovery includes one reload, retry or simplifying the dataset. A durable hosted application is a Site.
observations.acceptance: Verify control semantics, keyboard, state reset, failure fallback and replacement identity; no claim of uniform controls.
observations.classification: official help documentation; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Chart query lineage and data freshness
observations.description: A chart can expose its underlying query and last refresh time; title, caption and chart are directly editable. This is an inspectable metric provenance pattern rather than an assurance that a query is correct.
observations.acceptance: Verify query access, data definition, units, last refresh, editor controls and unauthorized access.
observations.classification: official help documentation; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Certified metric queries
observations.description: The beta query workflow has a certification toggle, additional context, Test and Publish; certification appears after a check. Non-certifying edits lose the badge; removing certification removes the badge from dependent dashboards.
observations.acceptance: Test pending verification, failed query, publish authorization, uncertified edit and dependent badge revocation.

observations.title: Read-only version preview and shared restore
observations.description: Dashboard version history includes direct edits; preview is read-only, restore creates its own history entry and changes the shared dashboard for readers.
observations.acceptance: Test preview vs restore, edit authorization, concurrent viewers, invalid versions and recovery.
observations.classification: official help documentation; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Scoped live data sharing
observations.description: By default viewers use their own connector access. Live sharing lets organization readers see results under the sharer's access, limited to dashboard queries; changing queries requires editor approval. This is separate from scheduled refresh, which the guide does not promise.
observations.acceptance: Verify query scope, approval, revocation, stale saved results and scheduled-vs-on-open distinction.
observations.classification: official help documentation; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Mind map branch disclosure and contextual chat
observations.description: Current Mind Maps help documents zoom, scroll, expand/collapse branches and node selection to ask a scoped chat question, along with full-view and download controls. The mobile app is not supported in this guide.
observations.acceptance: Test keyboard node traversal, collapse state, zoom limits, chat focus, download restriction and mobile availability.
observations.classification: official help documentation; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Schema-directed data table generation
observations.description: Customization allows specifying language and desired rows/columns through a prompt. The generated table is source-grounded and can be exported; the examples are not fixed schema templates.
observations.acceptance: Verify source selection, custom columns, citations, empty/missing data, long cells, export and accessibility.

observations.title: Focused chat view versus security boundary
observations.description: Chat View hides source/artifact surfaces for a focused experience, but does not revoke underlying notebook access. Public artifact links have different sign-in behavior from whole notebook links.
observations.acceptance: Test hidden vs denied resources, direct links, role changes and sharing warning.
observations.classification: official help documentation; acceptance checks not executed

observations.title: Source Q&A versus experimental agentic chat
observations.description: The chat guide describes source-grounded answers and citation navigation, but separately lists experimental agentic capabilities with or without sources (research, code and file/chart outputs). Do not equate these modes or promise all answers are source-only.
observations.acceptance: Test explicit source mode, external sources, tool action review and unsupported export; distinguish generated claims and citations.

observations.title: Initial automatic artifact generation
observations.description: The notebook creation guide says some first-source sessions can generate an initial report, study aid or media artifact automatically once, outside normal generation limits.
observations.acceptance: Check user visibility, cancel/disable if available, unwanted output cleanup and quota; do not infer universal trigger.
